label: h/1/m input at original step 3-4 in sequences starting with s
explanation: Very sparse, weak unit (max activation 0.009). It fires only in the original phase, almost all at t=3 (84% of mass) or t=4 (15%), never at t<3, at t>5, on the delimiter, or during the copy phase. The input token is nearly always h (68% of mass), 1 (20%) or m (9%), and the input is usually the first time that token appears. It also depends strongly on the prefix: first token s (66% of mass, 18x lift), then r, f, x, d. The largest activations are h at t=3 after an s-initial prefix such as s r 0 h. Many h/1/m-at-t=3 steps with an s or r prefix stay inactive, so it is conditioned on the hidden state left by the specific prefix tokens, and no simple history variable captured that. Best simple predicate: dev F1 about 0.41, mass recall 0.63.
